title: Remote Water Resilience Controller evidence-hardening study

target.reason: Independent final evaluation, release binding, domain review, and operational lifecycle evidence are not complete.

planner_may_not: append directly to the intent journal
modify checkpoints, thresholds, scenarios, or evidence

hard_gates: No declared safety invariant violation in any selection, combined-fault, or deterministic randomized scenario.
Exact deterministic replay from identical identified inputs.
Exact monotonically increasing intent sequence across checkpoint restart.
Every injected checkpoint corruption is rejected without changing live state.
Every candidate scenario passes the predeclared per-scenario regression limits.
Experimental contract-profile and assurance-case schema validation.

selection_objective.scope: The six frozen selection scenarios only; robustness scenarios cannot retroactively change the selection corpus.
selection_objective.primary: Reduce total pump starts across the frozen selection suite.
selection_objective.selection_rule: Hard gates dominate. The objective is evaluated only after every hard gate passes.

terminal_state_normalization.method: Normalize candidate energy to the baseline terminal stored-water inventory using the declared duty-pump marginal kWh per stored liter.
terminal_state_normalization.limitation: This corrects finite-horizon inventory borrowing but is not a hydraulic efficiency or pump-curve model.

requirements: The candidate and evaluator lock are committed before the runtime seed is generated.
Both architectures receive the same runtime seed and produce matching rounded comparison digests.
The workflow retains every result and forbids best-run selection.
The development repository owner is not treated as an independent evaluator.
A future formal claim still requires separately identified independent evaluation and release authority.
